findings.claim: R9's durable check has a blind spot inside the very Debt row it was built to protect: a quoted line ref written in the possessive form is not matched, so that ref can rot silently, and the case provenance's coverage number is off by one as a result.
findings.evidence: src/repo_hygiene/eval_adapter.py:213-215 — LEDGER_LINE_REF_RE allows only `\s*(?:reads|says)?\s*\(?\s*` between the closing backtick and the opening quote. tasks/TODO.md:210 (the R1 Debt row) writes `ADR-021:211`'s "no real filing joined the corpus since" — the possessive blocks the match, so the ref is neither verified nor counted. Rewriting :211 to :911 leaves the check returning [] and invariant 61/61. Consequently the case provenance's '9 of roughly 60 refs quote their target and are therefore checkable' understates the quoting population: 10 quote their target, 9 are checkable. The ref itself resolves correctly today, so nothing is currently stale.
findings.repro: python3 -c "import sys,json,pathlib; sys.path.insert(0,'.'); import src.repo_hygiene.eval_adapter as A; case=json.load(open('evals/adversarial/ledger-line-refs.json')); p=pathlib.Path('tasks/TODO.md'); o=p.read_text(); p.write_text(o.replace('\u0060ADR-021:211\u0060','\u0060ADR-021:911\u0060')); print(A.check_ledger_line_refs(case) or 'GREEN (missed)'); p.write_text(o)"
findings.acceptance: The possessive form is matched (or the one ref rewritten into the matched form), min_refs rises to 10, the :211 -> :911 mutation goes RED through `python3 -m evals.run --suite invariant`, and the provenance states the quoting and checkable populations as the same number.

findings.claim: check_ledger_line_refs can be satisfied vacuously: a ref whose quotation is 4-5 characters long counts toward the min_refs floor but verifies nothing, so a completely bogus line number passes.
findings.evidence: src/repo_hygiene/eval_adapter.py:245-249 — n_refs += 1 happens before the fragment loop, and the loop continues on any normalized piece shorter than 6 chars, while LEDGER_LINE_REF_RE accepts a fragment as short as 4. Replacing `README.md:92` reads "Full rationale in ... (18 ADRs)" with `README.md:9999` reads "zzzz" — a line that does not exist — returns [] and still counts 9 refs, so both the value check and the floor are satisfied by a ref that checks nothing. No instance of this shape exists in the committed tree today; this is an erosion path, not a live defect.
findings.repro: python3 -c "import sys,json,pathlib; sys.path.insert(0,'.'); import src.repo_hygiene.eval_adapter as A; case=json.load(open('evals/adversarial/ledger-line-refs.json')); p=pathlib.Path('tasks/TODO.md'); o=p.read_text(); p.write_text(o.replace('\u0060README.md:92\u0060 reads \"Full rationale in \u0060specs/decisions/\u0060 (18 ADRs)\"','\u0060README.md:9999\u0060 reads \"zzzz\"')); print(A.check_ledger_line_refs(case) or 'GREEN (vacuous)'); p.write_text(o)"
